changelog: v1.6.2: 88-scenario comprehensive test (10 categories: Daily Life, Work, Study, Programming, Shopping, Health, Travel, Entertainment, News, Edge Cases). Result: 85/88 passed (97%). Fixes: (1) Chinese question-word + brand rewrite ('怎么注册支付宝' → '支付宝 Alipay 注册支付宝') — Bing was returning dictionary entry for '怎么'. (2) Mixed CJK/Latin locale detection — 'iPhone 15 Pro 价格' now correctly detects zh-CN (was en-US → Korean results). (3) 特斯拉 rewrite strengthened. Per-category: Work/Programming/Health/Travel/Entertainment/Edge 100%, Daily Life/Shopping 100% after fix, Study 87%, News 75%.
